profile_stats.definition: select p.id,(select count(*) from public.bottles b where b.owner_id=p.id) as bottles_count,(select count(*) from public.follows f where f.followee_id=p.id) as followers_count,(select count(*) from public.follows f where f.follower_id=p.id) as following_count,(select round(avg(v.rating),1) from public.reviews v where v.reviewee_id=p.id) as rating from public.profiles p

non_constraint_indexes: CREATE INDEX bottles_owner_idx ON public.bottles USING btree (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX bottles_swappable_idx ON public.bottles USING btree (trade_available) WHERE trade_available
CREATE INDEX trade_messages_trade_idx ON public.trade_messages USING btree (trade_id, sent_at)
